title: Verification checklist and user manual docs (nominal latency, monoSource, automation caveats, LV2 host notes)
description:
Author release documentation only: CI verification checklist and end-user manual. Wave-1 independent of e.1–e.4.

Before editing, inspect:
- .abracapocus/ShredWidth_Build_Spec.md §§4.9, 5, 10, 12, 14, 16 (latency nominal PDC, monoSource D8, formats, presets, verification items, open-decision defaults)
- Factory preset names/values from phase goal / §12
- ParameterIDs inventory (latencyMode automatable but discouraged live; monoSource hidden)

Implement:
1. docs/verification/shredwidth_verification.md — checklist mapping §14 CI-runnable items:
   1 RT-safety (scripts/check_rt_safety.sh + ScopedNoDenormals)
   2 determinism/null
   3 bypass null
   4 Mix=0 passthrough
   5 mono-lows invariant
   6 unity-gain crossfade
   7 pitch accuracy
   8 correlation sanity
   9 latency report (1024 Studio / 256 Live)
   10 pluginval VST3/CLAP strictness 8+ and LV2/Standalone smoke (scripts/run_pluginval.sh)
   Honest note: ear-pass and full host matrix are manual, not CI-gated.
   Point operators at ctest/test targets and the two scripts; leave cmake resolution to build_all.sh (not on PATH).

2. docs/shredwidth_manual.md — user-facing manual covering:
   - What ShredWidth is (static dual-head micro-pitch detuner + Haas + mono-safe highs width; no LFO)
   - Nominal (not sample-exact) latency / PDC; Studio vs Live buffer modes
   - Hidden monoSource (Sum default vs Left); not on main GUI in v1
   - latencyMode is automatable but live automation is discouraged (buffer repoint + brief masked crossfade)
   - LV2 host port-metadata / latency refresh caveat
   - Output Trim default 0 dB; formats VST3/CLAP/LV2/Standalone (no AU)
   - Factory preset descriptions: Tight Lead, Wide Lead, Huge Solo, Mono-Safe Subtle, Live Tracking with the §12 numeric vignettes
   - Brief mono-safe design note (shared lows stay centered)

Do not edit CMakeLists, sources, presets, or scripts.
acceptance_criteria: docs/verification/shredwidth_verification.md exists and lists §14 checks 1–10 including RT-safety, determinism/null, bypass null, Mix=0, mono-lows, unity-gain crossfade, pitch accuracy, correlation sanity, latency report, pluginval
docs/verification/shredwidth_verification.md states ear-pass and full host matrix are manual
docs/shredwidth_manual.md exists and documents nominal (not sample-exact) latency and Studio/Live modes
docs/shredwidth_manual.md documents hidden monoSource default Sum, latencyMode automation discouraged, LV2 host port-metadata note, and the five factory presets
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: claim AU support or sample-exact granular latency
omit the manual ear-pass / host-matrix honesty note

allowed: markdown structure with headings and checklists
cross-link relative paths to scripts and Resources/Presets
short operator vs user voice split across the two docs
forbidden: rewrite the full Build Spec into the manual
document non-default open decisions as if selected (AU on, LR4-only, etc.)
